topics.topic: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce: Online storefronts, social media marketing, and SEO in Nigeria
learningObjectives: Define digital marketing and trace the rise of Nigerian e-commerce platforms (Jumia, Konga, Payporte)
Examine social media commerce (Instagram shopping, WhatsApp Business, TikTok storefronts)
Explain basic Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Pay-Per-Click (PPC) digital advertising techniques

topics.topic: Electronic Payment Gateways and Mobile Banking in Retail Trade (Paystack, Flutterwave, Moniepoint)
learningObjectives: Analyze payment channels: POS card terminals, USSD codes, mobile banking apps, and digital wallets
Evaluate benefits of cashless transactions for retailers: reduced cash theft, sales tracking, and customer convenience
Examine security risks: card skimming, phishing fraud, network downtime, and statutory fraud remedies

topics.topic: International Marketing: Export and import procedures, foreign market entry modes
learningObjectives: Define international marketing and identify drivers of global commerce (comparative cost, market saturation)
Analyze modes of foreign market entry: direct exporting, licensing, franchising, joint ventures, and FDI
Evaluate socio-cultural, political, and currency risks encountered in global marketing expansions

topics.topic: Export Trade Procedures in Nigeria: Nigerian Export Promotion Council (NEPC) and Documentation
learningObjectives: Detail registration procedures for non-oil exporters with NEPC
Examine key statutory export documents: Clean Certificate of Inspection (CCI), Bill of Lading, Form NXP, Certificate of Origin
Analyze high-demand Nigerian agricultural exports (cocoa, sesame seeds, cashew nuts, ginger, shea butter)

topics.topic: Consumer Protection and Statutory Regulatory Agencies: FCCPC, SON, and NAFDAC
learningObjectives: Examine consumer rights under the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC) Act
Explain the mandate of Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON) in enforcing MANCAP and SONCAP quality standards
Analyze NAFDAC’s role in curbing fake pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and packaged food products

topics.topic: Sales Management and Sales Force Administration: Recruitment, training, territories, and quotas
learningObjectives: Explain the organizational functions of a corporate sales manager
Design sales territories based on geographical regions, customer types, and workload balance
Formulate sales incentive packages: base salary, sales commissions, bonuses, and non-financial recognition

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Mock Export Enterprise Seminar
learningObjectives: Assess pupil comprehension of digital marketing, export documentation, and consumer protection law
Conduct a simulated business seminar on 'Developing a Non-Oil Export Strategy for Nigerian SMEs'
Remediate common confusion regarding export documentation and trade financing

topics.topic: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Customer Retention Strategies
learningObjectives: Define Customer Relationship Management (CRM) as a strategy for maximizing customer lifetime value
Contrast the economic cost of acquiring new customers versus retaining existing loyal customers
Analyze loyalty programs, after-sales service, and omnichannel customer support systems

topics.topic: Marketing of Financial, Educational, and Health Services in Nigeria
learningObjectives: Identify unique characteristics of services: intangibility, inseparability, variability, and perishability
Formulate marketing strategies for retail commercial banks, fintech apps, and insurance policies
Examine promotional tactics used by private universities and healthcare diagnostic centers

topics.topic: Strategic Marketing Planning: SWOT Analysis and Competitive Advantage
learningObjectives: Conduct a comprehensive SWOT analysis (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) for commercial enterprises
Explain Michael Porter's generic strategies: Cost Leadership, Differentiation, and Focus
Draft an operational marketing plan complete with executive summary, budget, and implementation timeline

topics.topic: Social Responsibility and Marketing Ethics: Truthful advertising and green marketing
learningObjectives: Analyze ethical dilemmas in marketing: bait-and-switch pricing, planned obsolescence, pyramid schemes
Explain green marketing and corporate environmental sustainability initiatives
Foster adherence to fair commercial practices and consumer respect among prospective entrepreneurs

topics.topic: Comprehensive WASSCE/NECO Marketing Revision & Past Paper Marathon
learningObjectives: Review cumulative senior secondary marketing syllabus across the 4 Ps, salesmanship, e-commerce, and export trade
Execute timed speed drills on 50 objective questions and 4 structured case study questions
Coach students on maximizing scores through clear definitions, diagrams, and Nigerian business examples

topics.topic: Terminal Mock Examination and Broadsheet Entry
learningObjectives: Administer comprehensive mock WASSCE Marketing examination under official testing conditions
Grade answers in strict accordance with WAEC marking schemes and rubric standards
Certify final continuous assessment grades for graduation records and transcripts
